name: Exp_WPR_Histogram
summary: This EA trades based on the WPR (Williams' Percent Range) Histogram indicator, opening buy positions when the histogram shows bullish momentum above the high level and sell positions when it shows bearish momentum below the low level. It uses a custom WPR_Histogram indicator with configurable overbought/oversold levels and signal bar selection, combined with money management modes for position sizing. Trade exits are triggered by opposing signals from the histogram.
summary_zh: 该EA基于WPR（威廉指标）直方图指标进行交易，当直方图显示看涨动量超过高位时开多仓，显示看跌动量低于低位时开空仓。它使用自定义WPR_Histogram指标，配合可配置的超买/超卖水平和信号K线选择，以及多种资金管理模式进行仓位管理。交易出场由直方图的反向信号触发。
strategy_analysis: 该策略基于威廉指标（WPR）的直方图变体进行动量交易。入场条件：当直方图颜色缓冲区（buffer 2）值为0且直方图值（buffer 0）大于0时，产生买入信号，表示价格处于超买区域上方的强势动量；当缓冲区值为2且直方图值小于2时，产生卖出信号，表示价格处于超卖区域下方的弱势动量。出场条件：买入信号的对面触发卖出平仓（SELL_Close=true），卖出信号的对面触发买入平仓（BUY_Close=true），即反向信号出场。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode模式控制，支持基于自由保证金、余额、损失后余额、损失后自由保证金和固定手数五种模式。资金管理方面，止损和止盈分别默认为1000和2000点，允许较大的价格波动空间。策略使用SignalBar参数决定在哪根K线上读取信号，默认为前一根已收盘K线（值=1），避免未收盘K线的信号漂移问题。
strategy_analysis_en: This strategy trades momentum based on a histogram variant of the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the histogram color buffer (buffer 2) equals 0 and the histogram value (buffer 0) is greater than 0, indicating bullish momentum above the overbought threshold; a sell signal is generated when buffer 2 equals 2 and the histogram value is less than 2, indicating bearish momentum below the oversold threshold. Exit conditions: an opposing signal triggers position closure — a buy signal closes sell positions (SELL_Close=true) and a sell signal closes buy positions (BUY_Close=true), implementing a signal-reversal exit model. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting five modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management features stop loss and take profit defaults of 1000 and 2000 points respectively, providing substantial room for price fluctuation. The strategy uses the SignalBar parameter to determine which bar to read signals from, defaulting to the previous closed bar (value=1), which avoids signal repaint issues from unclosed bars.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Margin usage ratio for lot size calculation

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/损失后余额等）
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode (free margin/balance/net loss/fixed lots)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于判断信号的K线索引（0=当前K线，1=前一根已收盘K线）

pros: 使用已收盘K线信号（SignalBar=1），避免信号重绘问题，提高信号可靠性
提供完整的多空开仓和平仓开关，灵活性高，可单独控制多空方向
内置五种资金管理模式，适应不同风险偏好和账户规模
有新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），避免同一根K线内重复开仓
止损和止盈参数完整，具备基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Uses closed bar signal (SignalBar=1) to avoid signal repainting, improving signal reliability
Provides complete buy/sell open and close toggle switches with high flexibility for directional control
Built-in five money management modes to accommodate different risk preferences and account sizes
Includes new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated entries within the same bar
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters providing a basic risk control framework
cons: 没有点差过滤，在点差较大时可能导致入场价格不利，尤其对短线交易影响显著
缺少持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
止损1000点和止盈2000点设置过大，在低波动性市场中可能长期无法止盈
依赖自定义指标WPR_Histogram，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行且错误处理不够健壮
没有追踪止损或移动止损功能，无法在盈利后锁定浮盈
cons_en: No spread filter, which can lead to unfavorable entry prices during high spread conditions, especially impactful for short-term trading
Lacks position checking logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction when one already exists
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large, potentially preventing timely exits in low-volatility markets
Depends on custom WPR_Histogram indicator — if the indicator file is missing, the EA fails with insufficient error handling
No trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits after favorable price movement
improvements: 添加点差过滤条件，在点差超过阈值时暂停开仓，避免不利滑点
增加持仓检查逻辑，在开仓前确认是否存在同方向持仓，防止重复开仓
加入追踪止损功能，在价格朝有利方向移动时自动调整止损以锁定利润
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to pause new entries when spread exceeds a configurable threshold, avoiding unfavorable slippage
Add position checking logic before opening trades to confirm no existing same-direction positions, preventing duplicate entries
Implement a trailing stop feature to automatically adjust stop loss when price moves favorably, locking in profits

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，高波动时段点差扩大可能导致不必要的亏损入场
没有持仓检查，可能在同一方向上重复建仓导致过度敞口
止损止盈点数固定，未根据市场波动性（ATR）动态调整
risk_points_en: No spread filter — widened spreads during high volatility periods can cause unnecessary losing entries
No position check — potentially building excessive exposure by opening duplicate same-direction positions
Fixed stop loss and take profit in points, not dynamically adjusted based on market volatility (ATR)
